text:
Aisha: quick async check — EdgeBridge onprem rollout is hitting a couple last-mile issues, want to capture ownership and unblock the CRs. milestone: staging smoke by 03/30.

Ben: which CRs exactly? I saw a failing egress test in the canary runs earlier.

Aisha: two CRs:  #4821 (egress-fallback-config) and #4830 (artifacts-registry-auth). both are code-reviewed but blocked on infra review and net owner sign-off.

Evan: I can take infra review on #4821 today. quick note: the prober fails when NATting to 10.10.0.0/16 — guessing SNAT conflict with customer firewall.

Kai: @net-ops can you confirm whether we reserve the 10.10/16 space for tenant bridges? last doc showed dynamic assignment but customer uses it too.

net-ops: we do not reserve it; we can move tenant bridge to 10.11/16 as a patch but need coordination with customer. any chance to overlap?

Carla: customer (Oakwell Health) requires air-gapped artifact access. #4830 adds an onprem pull-through registry config + signed key rotation. blocked because onprem package signing needs ops-driven GPG key import into their HSM.

Maya: I have contact with their infra lead, can coordinate key import with their security team. timeline?

Aisha: ideal: key import + registry smoke by EOD 03/28, otherwise we miss SLA for staging.

Ben: small network config I found in logs — probe shows TLS handshake timeout to registry:443 after routing switch. paste of failing curl: ```curl -v https://artifact-registry.local:443 --resolve artifact-registry.local:443:10.11.5.20``` -> TLS handshake timeout.

Evan: could be MTU or SNI mismatch with their reverse proxy. can we get TCP dumps from their edge box? request: sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 host 10.11.5.20 and share pcap.

Maya: will ask them for pcap and cert chain. expecting response within 2 hours.

deploy-bot: Canary run 2026-03-24T09:12:30Z -> egress-prober failed (exit 1). link: https://ci.internal/runs/8876

Carla: Regarding CR #4821, infra review notes: need fallback policy to prefer regional hosted variant before using local cache. we lost that in the last change. Evan, can you add a policy comment?

Evan: I'll push a tiny change to the policy and ping infra review. PR -> https://git.redwood/infra/4821 (wip).

Aisha: owner matrix update: infra review -> Evan, net owner -> @Kai, customer ops liaison -> Maya, SRE smoke -> @sre-oncall, signoff target -> 03/29 noon PT.

Kai: I'll reserve 10.11/16 and update routing table entry on our side. note: needs firewall CR from customer to allow 10.11.5.0/24 -> 172.31.0.0/16.

Maya: got confirmation from their infra lead: they can patch firewall tomorrow morning but need the exact IPs. Ben, can you share the final CIDR list?

Ben: final CIDRs: 10.11.5.0/24 (registry), 10.11.6.0/24 (egress-prober), 172.31.20.0/24 (Redwood exit). I'll paste a compact snippet for them: ```allow from 10.11.5.0/24 to 172.31.20.0/24 tcp/443; allow from 10.11.6.0/24 to 172.31.20.0/24 tcp/443```

net-ops: confirm we can accept those ranges. will pre-stage routes and add NAT rule once customer confirms.

Aisha: next blockers: 1) pcap/TLS chain from customer, 2) firewall CR applied, 3) infra review merged. If all three done we run full staging smoke. mark owners above.

Carla: small ask — can someone tag the prod-ops runbook with the exact recovery steps for fallback? I keep hitting ambiguity for the registry failover.

Evan: adding step-by-step to the runbook now, will PR in ~15m.

Maya: customer responded — they can run tcpdump at 11:30 PT and share. I'll upload here when I get it.

sre-oncall: FYI if staging fails we should flip canary to hosted fallback. I can run the rollback if needed, please ping me with the run id.

Aisha: perfect. last thing: who will finalize the onprem packaging smoke? Ben or Evan?

Ben: I can do packaging smoke once Evan merges #4821. expect ~1h post-merge.

Aisha: thanks all — I'll update the owner matrix doc and mark this thread for follow-ups. :white_check_mark: 

-- end thread --
